MAINICHI

JAPANESE MARINES AND SAILORS TO HOLD
JOINT PARADE

It is reported that at 10 a.m.
January 7 Japanese marines and sailors will hold
a joint parade under Vice-Admiral Ohikawa, Commander
of the Japanese Fleet in China waters, and Rear-
Admiral Takeda, Commander of the Japanese Special
Naval Landing Party. The mechanised unit will
parade on Kiangwan Road and the marines and sailors
in Hongkew Park.
The marines and sailors will march
along the following routes:-
The 1st Company: Kiangwan Road, North Szechuen
Road, Paoshan Road and Jukong Road.
The 2nd Company: North Szechuen Road, Dixwell
Road, Urga Road, Sinkee Pang Road and Seward Road.
The 3rd Company: Kiangwan Road, North Szechuen
Road, Tientungan Road, Paoshing Road, Chungshan
Road and Kungwo Sing Road.
The 4th Company: Kiangwan Road, West Recreation
Club Road, Euyang Road, Ziang Tuh Road, North Szechuen
Road and in front of the Chiyo Yoko.
The 5th Company: North Szechuen Road, North
Soochow Road and in front of the Japanese Consulate-
General.
The 6th Company: North Szechuen Road, Dixwell
Road, Kashing Road, Woosung Road and in front of the
Japanese Imperial Telegraph Office.
The mechanised unit: Kiangwan Road and North
Szechuen Road.

《每日新闻》

日本海军陆战队与水兵将举行联合阅兵

据报，1月7日上午10时，日本海军陆战队与水兵将在驻华水域日本舰队司令大川（Ohikawa）海军中将及日本特别海军陆战队司令武田（Takeda）海军少将的指挥下举行联合阅兵。机械化部队将在江湾路行进，海军陆战队与水兵则在虹口公园集结。

海军陆战队与水兵将按下列路线行进：

第一中队：江湾路、北四川路、宝山路及虬江路。

第二中队：北四川路、狄思威路（Dixwell Road）、乌尔嘎路（Urga Road）、新记浜路（Sinkee Pang Road）及华德路。

第三中队：江湾路、北四川路、天潼路、宝兴路、中山路及公平路。

第四中队：江湾路、西娱乐会路（West Recreation Club Road）、欧阳路、祥德路（Ziang Tuh Road）、北四川路，并在千代洋行（Chiyo Yoko）前集结。

第五中队：北四川路、北苏州路，并在日本总领事馆前集结。

第六中队：北四川路、狄思威路（Dixwell Road）、嘉兴路、吴淞路，并在日本帝国电信局前集结。

机械化部队：江湾路及北四川路。
